overview: The City Council approved several infrastructure and policy resolutions, including inquiries into using parking receipts to fund a traffic engineer, offsetting MBTA assessments, and monitoring water leaks. The council also heard extensive public comment regarding the proposed Clippership Connector path and Logan Airport aircraft noise over Medford.

items.title: 17-423: Fire Training Tower updates
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting monthly updates from the Fire Training Tower Committee regarding potential sites for a new facility.

items.title: 17-424: Open Space Plan
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting that a copy of the city's open space plan be forwarded to the Community Preservation Commission.

items.title: 17-425: Parking receipts and traffic engineer funding
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting legal and financial opinions on earmarking parking meter receipts under state law to fund a municipal traffic engineer and traffic calming measures.

items.title: 17-426: Commendation for Stephen Scaparrotti
items.summary: Approved a resolution commending Special Olympics gold medalist Stephen Scaparrotti and inviting him to receive a council citation.

items.title: 17-427: Sidewalk and street repairs
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting sidewalk repairs near Lawrence Memorial Hospital and Grove Street, tree stump removal on Saunders Street, and a paving schedule for Governors Avenue.

items.title: 17-428: MBTA assessment offset proposal
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting the city solicitor and state delegation draft legislation allowing the city to offset its MBTA assessment against the value of tax-exempt MBTA property in Medford.

items.title: 17-429: Water and sewer leak detection program
items.summary: Approved a resolution discussing unaccounted-for water and requesting an update on acoustic leak detection technology and the new water and sewer rate structure.

items.title: 17-422: Committee report on water and sewer enterprise accounts
items.summary: Adopted a Committee of the Whole report regarding water and sewer accounts, connection fees, and leak detection updates.

items.title: 17-421: Committee report and public comment on Clippership Connector
items.summary: Adopted the Committee of the Whole report on the Clippership Connector path after several residents and bicycle advocates spoke strongly in favor of completing the riverfront trail and working with abutters.

items.title: 17-432: Commendations for retired firefighters
items.summary: Approved commendations and citations for eight Medford firefighters who retired in 2016 and 2017.

items.title: 17-430: Housing Authority emergency preparedness update
items.summary: Discussed a response from the Medford Housing Authority detailing new emergency evacuation protocols and elevator backup generator plans, and invited the new executive director to speak to the council.

items.title: 17-431: Condolence on the passing of Reverend Edward F. Dowdy
items.summary: Approved a resolution offering condolences to the family of former St. Francis and St. Joseph's pastor Reverend Edward F. Dowdy.

items.title: Retirement commendation for Jack McDevitt
items.summary: Approved a resolution commending long-time teacher and cemetery trustee Jack McDevitt on his retirement from public service.

items.title: Condolence on the passing of Sammy Petrala
items.summary: Approved a resolution extending condolences on the passing of local businessman Sammy Petrala.

items.title: Opposition comments on proposed cell phone towers
items.summary: Approved submitting council comments opposing proposed cell phone towers at 63 Tyler Avenue and 59 Charnwood Avenue due to proximity to historic sites.

items.title: Clippership Day commendation
items.summary: Approved a resolution thanking the Chamber of Commerce, city departments, and volunteers for organizing Clippership Day.

items.title: Aircraft noise impacts from Logan Airport
items.summary: Discussed severe airplane noise and pollution impacts resulting from concentrated flight paths over Medford, with councilors and residents urging increased Massport complaints, federal legislative action, and noise monitor reviews.

items.title: Paving update for Paris Street
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a construction schedule from the DPW for the planned paving of Paris Street.
